newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Leighton says first half on budget.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Leighton says first half on budget.

text.p: Australia's largest construction group Leighton Holdings Ltd said on Friday it expected the first half to end-December to come in on budget.

Managing director Wal King said after the annual general meeting that 1996/97 revenue should be around A$2.7-A$2.8 billion, up from A$2.52 billion in 1995/96. "We would expect a commensurate increase in profit," he added.
Leighton reported a net profit of A$70.21 million for the year to June 30, up from A$51.25 million in 1994/95.
"The first half will be more or less on budget for the year," King said.
King said a number of Leighton's core activities fell within growth sectors of the Australian economy, such aS mining, resources infrastructure and commercial construction.
"We see great opportunities in the market co-existing with tough times. It depends on where you are working," he said.
Building and infrastructure would bE strong in New South Wales, with a boost from the Olympics, while mining activity would be strong in Queensland and Western Australia.
In Asia, which last year provided 20 percent of Leighton's revenue, King saw good opportunities in Hong Kong and Indonesia, and to a lesser extent in Thailand and Malaysia.
